args.instruction: board up this part of the building: nail weathered wooden planks across every window and door, dark unlit glass, grey dust sheets hanging inside, no lamps lit; keep the building's shape, roofs, walls, colours, the sky, the grounds, the composition and the framing exactly identical, make only these changes

remove the building in the middle of the picture completely and leave its plot as empty mown lawn with the same grass as around it; keep everything else, the paths, trees, hedges, the composition and the framing exactly identical

blend the building in the middle into the surrounding lawn so the whole picture is one coherent painting: matching soft evening light and colour, a soft contact shadow where it meets the grass, its base settled naturally into the lawn; make only subtle changes, do not move, redraw or re-frame anything, keep its shape, position and size identical
